name: uchiha-radius
description: Multi-tenant ISP operations platform: provider app, owner console, RADIUS/MikroTik connectors and Telegram alerts.

scripts.mobile:prepare: npm run provider:v183:mobile && node scripts/build-mobile-assets.mjs owner
scripts.provider:v183:fast: node scripts/build-provider-v183.mjs server && node scripts/build-fast-v183.mjs && node scripts/check-fast-v183.mjs
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npm run sync --workspace @uchiha-radius/provider-mobile && npm run sync --workspace @uchiha-radius/owner-mobile
scripts.mobile:build:debug: npm run mobile:sync && npm run android:debug --workspace @uchiha-radius/provider-mobile && npm run android:debug --workspace @uchiha-radius/owner-mobile
